title: Layer 3 round 5 nit collector: the composition set's human vocabulary takes the no-op PostLoad (latent until a later layer prints it); post_load runs after schema minLength so an all-format-char field cleans to empty

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 52f94321: CompositionScopeAndActions gained a post_load cleaning its action human text and scope whitepaper names — the clean-at-source invariant now holds for that set too, latent-safe against a later layer wiring those strings to a print. The post-clean-empty edge (a schema-legal all-format-char field cleaning to empty after minLength passed) is documented in the text.rs scope note as an accepted degenerate rendering — the render layer words an empty value as its registered absence, so it is safe, not a schema breach to re-diagnose.
